messages:
Nina L: Heads-up: I found 47 invoices where a billing adjustment line (seat downgrade proration) shows up twice in NetSuite after last night's batch retries. Affected window 2026-03-18 01:50-02:05 UTC.

Carlos R: Did any retry mechanism run during that window?

Nina L: Yes, ops retried a failed stripe-webhook-processor DLQ between 01:58-02:02 (ticket BILL-4278).

Ashwin: Quick diagnosis: the DLQ redriver reconstructs payloads but doesn't preserve the original X-Idempotency-Key header. Our webhook consumer dedupes using that header + stripe_event_id. Without it, the redriven events get treated as fresh and create invoice adjustments again.

Billing Bot: [alert] invoice-sync job failed to reconcile duplicates at 2026-03-18T02:06:48Z. Logs: /logs/billing/2026-03-18/02.

Nina L: Sample logs show two NS calls for same stripe_event:

```
2026-03-18T01:59:05Z INFO billing sync createAdjustment {"cust":"cust_900","amount":-75,"meta":{"stripe_evt":"evt_xyz"}}
2026-03-18T01:59:06Z INFO billing sync createAdjustment response 200 id=ns_1201
2026-03-18T02:00:12Z INFO billing sync createAdjustment {"cust":"cust_900","amount":-75,"meta":{"stripe_evt":"evt_xyz"}}
2026-03-18T02:00:13Z INFO billing sync createAdjustment response 200 id=ns_1202
```

Carlos R: Oof. What's the scope?

Nina L: Query returned 47 invoice_nums with >1 adjustment line in that window. Total duplicate amount ~ $1,760.

Ashwin: Short term: I've asked Ops to pause DLQ redrives and updated the requeue tool to copy headers. Also added a defensive check in the billing worker to ignore adjustments where stripe_evt already exists in billing_events.

CS Ops: We already have one customer ticket opened, CS-6201. I'll prioritize outreach for customers with delta > $100.

Nina L: Remediation plan: 1) generate CSV of ns ids, invoice numbers, duplicate adjustment ids 2) Finance to approve voiding the later NS adjustment (prefer void vs journal) 3) run voids in dry-run then live 4) reconcile ledger once voids applied. I'm preparing the sheet: https://go/gdoc/dup-adjust-2026-03-18 (internal).

Carlos R: Finance signoff needed. Also add a post-deploy test in infra that simulates DLQ redrive and asserts idempotency header preserved. Filing infra#5489.

Ashwin: Will add a backfill to find billing_events with null idempotency headers and flag them for manual review. Dry-run script ready; pushing artifact /artifacts/2026-03-18/dup-adjust-dryrun-2167123456.csv

Billing Bot: [info] dry-run returned 47 candidates, total $1760. See artifact above.

Nina L: I'll review CSV and coordinate with CS Ops. Do not run voids until Finance ack.

Carlos R: Ack. After fixes, add an alert: "duplicate-adjustments > 10 in 1h" to detect regressions quickly.

Ashwin: noted. Will include tests and revert the redrive pause once safe.

Nina L: Thanks everyone. Adding note to billing runbook about DLQ replays and preserving idempotency headers. :white_check_mark:
